description: Lists all Claude Code sessions for a project or globally, sorted by recency, size, or duration.

evals.name: List sessions for current project, sorted by recency
evals.prompt: List all sessions for this project, sorted by recency.
evals.expected_output: Runs session_store.py list with --format json and a --project filter matching the current directory, then presents a readable markdown table including session IDs and dates.

evals.name: List longest sessions across all projects, sorted by duration
evals.prompt: Show me my longest sessions across all projects, sorted by duration.
evals.expected_output: Runs session_store.py list --sort size (or duration-equivalent) with --format json, no --project filter, presents results sorted accordingly.

evals.name: Redirect chronological/pattern framing to session-timeline
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the chronological/pattern-oriented framing and redirects to session-timeline skill per the stated exclusion, rather than answering with a flat session-list table.
